_notes.method: One comment per income-statement line and per key cash-flow/RPO item for FY2026Q1-FY2027Q1. Year-over-year = same fiscal quarter one year earlier, on Oracle's FY2026 revenue captions (Cloud / Software / Hardware / Services), using the prior-year comparative column printed in each release. Drivers are taken only from the Exhibit 99.1 press release narrative, footnotes, income-statement, cash-flow and supplemental revenue tables, and from the call quotes already extracted in transcripts.json (cited as 'transcript p.N (speaker)'). Percentages are the ones Oracle prints; where Oracle prints none, the change is computed from the two figures in quarters.json and labelled as such. Verbatim management quotes are 12 words or fewer and in double quotes. Where neither source explains a line, the comment states the change and says 'no driver given by management' / 'la administracion no da una explicacion'.
_notes.caveats: Comments are ≤28 words and exec bullets ≤22 words, so they compress; the release and transcript remain the reference. Spanish is idiomatic Mexican business Spanish, not a literal translation. Guidance bullets for FY2026Q1 and FY2026Q2 come from the CFO's prepared remarks on the call because those releases printed no quantified guidance; from FY2026Q3 the release itself carries guidance. Restructuring_and_other combines Oracle's 'Restructuring' and 'Acquisition related and other' lines for Q1-Q3 FY2026 and is the single 'Restructuring and other' line from Q4 FY2026 (whose definition now also covers asset impairments). Discrete Q2-Q4 cash-flow figures are derived from cumulative statements as documented in quarters.json. Amounts in USD; 'bn' = billion (miles de millones), 'm' = million.

hardware.en: Up 15% (16% cc) to $774m, the strongest growth in the series; no driver given by management.
hardware.es: Subió 15% (16% cc) a US$774 millones, el mayor crecimiento de la serie; la administración no da una explicación.

services.en: Up 5% to $1.41bn, slower than Q4's 13%; no driver given by management.
services.es: Subió 5% a US$1,414 millones, menos que el 13% del 4T; la administración no da una explicación.

cloud_and_software_cost.en: Up 77% to $6.4bn vs revenue +30% (33% of revenue vs 24%): depreciation $3.16bn vs $1.35bn as 850MW came online; gross margin to flatten after the ramp (Maxson).
cloud_and_software_cost.es: Subió 77% a US$6.4 mil millones vs ingresos +30%: depreciación US$3,156 vs US$1,351 millones por los 850 MW nuevos; margen bruto se aplanará tras el arranque (Maxson).
cloud_and_software_cost.src: release income statement; cash-flow statement; transcript p.14 (Maxson)

hardware_cost.en: Up 58% (57% cc) to $281m, far ahead of hardware revenue +15%; no driver given by management.
hardware_cost.es: Subió 58% (57% cc) a US$281 millones, muy por encima de ingresos de hardware +15%; la administración no da una explicación.

services_cost.en: Down 4% to $1.05bn while services revenue rose 5%; no driver given by management.
services_cost.es: Bajó 4% a US$1,052 millones mientras los ingresos por servicios subieron 5%; la administración no da una explicación.

sales_and_marketing.en: Down 12% to $1.81bn, 9% of revenue vs 14%; follows the FY26 efficiency actions and restructuring; no further driver given.
sales_and_marketing.es: Bajó 12% a US$1,811 millones, 9% de ingresos vs 14%; sigue a las acciones de eficiencia y reestructuración del AF26; sin más explicación.
sales_and_marketing.src: release income statement; Q4 FY26 release narrative

research_and_development.en: Down 4% (3% cc) to $2.40bn, 12% of revenue vs 17%; R&D stock comp $667m vs $647m; follows the FY26 restructuring; no further driver given.
research_and_development.es: Bajó 4% (3% cc) a US$2,401 millones, 12% de ingresos vs 17%; compensación accionaria en I+D US$667 vs US$647 millones; sigue a la reestructuración AF26; sin más explicación.

general_and_administrative.en: Flat at $376m, 2% of revenue; G&A stock comp $98m vs $88m; no driver given by management.
general_and_administrative.es: Sin cambio en US$376 millones, 2% de ingresos; compensación accionaria en G&A US$98 vs US$88 millones; la administración no da una explicación.

amortization_of_intangibles.en: Down 52% to $202m as older acquired intangibles finished amortizing; remaining FY27 schedule $529m, FY28 $694m.
amortization_of_intangibles.es: Bajó 52% a US$202 millones al concluir la amortización de intangibles adquiridos más antiguos; resto de AF27 US$529 millones, AF28 US$694 millones.

restructuring_and_other.en: Down 77% to $94m from $415m as the FY26 restructuring program winds down; still excluded from non-GAAP.
restructuring_and_other.es: Bajó 77% a US$94 millones desde US$415 millones al desacelerarse el programa de reestructuración AF26; sigue excluida del No-GAAP.

operating_income.en: GAAP +57% to $6.7bn, margin 35% vs 29%; non-GAAP +31% to $8.2bn, margin 42%, "remained around flat" (Maxson) as lower opex offset higher cloud costs.
operating_income.es: GAAP +57% a US$6.7 mil millones, margen 35% vs 29%; No-GAAP +31% a US$8.2, margen 42%, prácticamente plano (Maxson): menor gasto operativo compensó mayores costos de nube.
operating_income.src: release p.1 narrative; non-GAAP reconciliation; transcript p.3 (Maxson)

interest_expense.en: Up 55% to $1.43bn on the $43bn of debt raised in FY26; total debt $125.3bn vs $91.3bn a year earlier, down from $129.5bn at May after $4.2bn repayments.
interest_expense.es: Subió 55% a US$1,428 millones por la deuda levantada en AF26 (US$43 mil millones); deuda total US$125.3 vs US$91.3 hace un año, menor a US$129.5 tras pagar US$4.2.
interest_expense.src: release income statement; balance sheet; cash-flow statement (financing)

nonoperating_income_net.en: $307m vs $73m (+323%); cash balance $36.4bn vs $10.4bn a year earlier; no explicit driver given by management.
nonoperating_income_net.es: US$307 millones vs US$73 millones (+323%); efectivo de US$36.4 mil millones vs US$10.4 hace un año; la administración no da una explicación explícita.

tax_provision.en: Up 69% to $847m on pretax +64%; GAAP rate 15.1% vs 14.6% (prior year included the OBBBA charge); non-GAAP rate 16.9% vs 20.5%.
tax_provision.es: Subió 69% a US$847 millones con utilidad antes de impuestos +64%; tasa GAAP 15.1% vs 14.6% (el año previo incluyó el cargo OBBBA); tasa No-GAAP 16.9% vs 20.5%.
tax_provision.src: release income statement footnote 2; reconciliation footnote 5

net_income_common.en: GAAP net income +63% to $4.8bn; after $81m preferred dividends, income to common $4.7bn, +60%; non-GAAP to common +34% to $5.8bn.
net_income_common.es: Utilidad neta GAAP +63% a US$4.8 mil millones; tras US$81 millones de dividendos preferentes, a comunes US$4.7 mil millones, +60%; No-GAAP a comunes +34% a US$5.8 mil millones.
net_income_common.src: release p.1 narrative; income statement; non-GAAP reconciliation

diluted_eps.en: GAAP $1.56 (+55%); non-GAAP $1.92 (+30%), above the $1.72-1.76 guide; diluted shares +3% to 3,000m after the $20bn ATM issuance.
diluted_eps.es: GAAP US$1.56 (+55%); No-GAAP US$1.92 (+30%), arriba de la guía de US$1.72-1.76; acciones diluidas +3% a 3,000 millones tras la emisión ATM de US$20 mil millones.
diluted_eps.src: release p.1 bullets; non-GAAP reconciliation; 'Capital Investment Program'

rpo.en: $664bn, +$209bn YoY and +$26bn sequentially after $30bn+ of new AI contracts, mostly prepaid or bring-your-own-hardware: "no incremental impact on its plans to raise capital".
rpo.es: US$664 mil millones, +US$209 interanual y +US$26 secuencial tras US$30+ mil millones en contratos de IA, casi todos prepagados o BYOH; sin afectar el plan de capital.
rpo.src: release 'Remaining Performance Obligations'; transcript p.3 (Maxson), p.6 (Magouyrk)

operating_cash_flow.en: Record $23.1bn vs $8.1bn (+184%): $11.4bn of customer prepayments with significant financing component plus $4.0bn other deferred revenue drove the swing (cash-flow statement).
operating_cash_flow.es: Récord de US$23.1 mil millones vs US$8.1 (+184%): US$11.4 de prepagos de clientes con componente de financiamiento y US$4.0 de otros ingresos diferidos explican el salto.
operating_cash_flow.src: release cash-flow statement; net-cash-outlay table; p.1 narrative

capex.en: $28.5bn vs $8.5bn; net cash outlay $18.0bn after $11.4bn prepayments; FCF -$5.4bn; FY27 capex "$90 billion to 95 billion" with net cash capex of at most $70bn (Maxson).
capex.es: US$28.5 mil millones vs US$8.5; desembolso neto US$18.0 tras US$11.4 de prepagos; flujo libre -US$5.4; capex AF27 de US$90-95 mil millones y neto de hasta US$70 (Maxson).
capex.src: release cash-flow statement; net-cash-outlay table; transcript p.4 (Maxson)

en: Record revenue $19.3bn, +30%; Cloud +62% with IaaS +121% after 850MW of new capacity; Software -3%.
Non-GAAP operating income +31% to $8.2bn, margin flat at 42%; S&M -12%, R&D -4%; cloud costs +77%.
Non-GAAP EPS $1.92 (+30%), above guidance; GAAP EPS $1.56 (+55%); diluted shares +3% after the ATM.
es: Ingresos récord de US$19.3 mil millones, +30%; Nube +62% con IaaS +121% tras 850 MW de nueva capacidad; Software -3%.
Utilidad operativa No-GAAP +31% a US$8.2 mil millones, margen plano en 42%; ventas -12%, I+D -4%; costos de nube +77%.
UPA No-GAAP US$1.92 (+30%), arriba de la guía; UPA GAAP US$1.56 (+55%); acciones diluidas +3% tras el ATM.

en: Q2 FY27: revenue +30-34%, cloud +64-70% cc (65-71% USD), non-GAAP EPS $1.85-1.93 USD (+21-25% ex-Ampere gain).
FY27 raised: revenue at least $90bn (+34%) and non-GAAP EPS $8.10; capex $90-95bn, net cash capex at most $70bn.
Around half of RPO expected to convert to revenue within 36 months; new Q1 contracts affect FY28 and beyond (Maxson).
es: 2T AF27: ingresos +30-34%, nube +64-70% cc (65-71% USD), UPA No-GAAP US$1.85-1.93 USD (+21-25% sin la ganancia de Ampere).
AF27 al alza: ingresos de al menos US$90 mil millones (+34%) y UPA No-GAAP US$8.10; capex US$90-95, neto hasta US$70.
Cerca de la mitad de las RPO se convertiría en ingresos en 36 meses; contratos nuevos del 1T impactan desde AF28 (Maxson).

en: Completed the $20bn at-the-market equity issuance in Q1 ($19.9bn net); stockholders' equity rose to $67.2bn.
Total debt $125.3bn after $4.2bn of repayments; cash and investments $37.1bn; interest expense +55% to $1.43bn.
New AI contracts structured as prepay or bring-your-own-hardware: "no incremental impact on its plans to raise capital".
es: Se completó la emisión ATM de US$20 mil millones en el 1T (US$19.9 netos); el capital contable subió a US$67.2 mil millones.
Deuda total US$125.3 mil millones tras pagar US$4.2; efectivo e inversiones US$37.1; gasto por intereses +55% a US$1,428 millones.
Los nuevos contratos de IA son prepagados o con hardware del cliente: sin impacto incremental en el plan de levantamiento de capital.

en: Operating cash flow of $23.1bn includes $11.4bn of customer prepayments: a timing benefit, not recurring operating cash.
Cloud and software costs +77% vs revenue +30%; GPU renewals at a 20% premium and 97.9% utilization support pricing (Magouyrk).
Q2 EPS will screen down 14-18% YoY against the Ampere-gain quarter (footnote 1); underlying growth guided at 21-25%.
es: El flujo operativo de US$23.1 mil millones incluye US$11.4 de prepagos de clientes: beneficio de calendario, no efectivo recurrente.
Costos de nube y software +77% vs ingresos +30%; renovaciones de GPU con prima de 20% y utilización 97.9% sostienen precios (Magouyrk).
La UPA del 2T caerá 14-18% interanual frente al trimestre de la ganancia de Ampere (nota 1); crecimiento subyacente guiado en 21-25%.

FY2027Q1.headline_en: Revenue +30% to a record $19.3bn as cloud infrastructure more than doubles; $20bn ATM completed and FY27 raised to at least $90bn.
FY2027Q1.headline_es: Ingresos +30% a un récord de US$19.3 mil millones con la infraestructura de nube más que duplicada; ATM de US$20 mil millones completado y AF27 sube a US$90 mil millones o más.
